nom: StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting ​Jawline & Neck Mask

avis.texte: I think I will have to try it again to really see a difference

avis.titre: My go to for firm and line free eyes!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about 3?years. Perfect for eye lid firming

Another Strivectin product that lives up to its hype. I have tried other cheaper products. But there are a couple of differences. Strivectin, you use a small amount. Other stuff. . it says to use a " generous amount ". Strivectin, it works. Other stuff. . it just sits there.

I truly believe this product helped me in my neck area. The jawline and neck became more firm and distinctive. I tried once , loved it and ordered two more times… now I purchased another product to try. But I am going to order Strivectin as my "to go mask" before any significant meetings.
And what this product because we were having family pictures done it did not work one bit
I was very pleased with the face mask and the results. I would purchase again.
Love this line of products. Really love them when I can catch them on sale.

This is a really neat product. I love that it is for a specific area and targets a weak spot for me. I love how the mask feels secure and adheres nicely. It's not like the runny feeling gel it is a nice adhesive gel that feels like it is really working on the area. 20 min to a sculpted neckline! Good product.

Followed instructions to the letter including using strivectin neck tightening serum with the roller applicator. Absolutely zero difference before and after. No fewer lines, no tightening, no lifting. Waste of money.
This felt amazing! It left my skin looking more firm than ever before! It was super comfortable! It is designed so well, and I loved getting to try this product out!
Love StriVectin my skin is looking great. I haven't all of it yet but I'm sure it will be fabulous The eye cream seems to make my eyes water

I was surprised that the ear loops also had the gelee, and that they actually stretched from ear to ear. The mask was def snug. I could talk but with minimal movement. It was not wet but more like a cool gel that was not messy at all because it was part of the fabric. I found that it made my skin soft, and I could feel a firmness to my skin. Sadly you cant see the difference but my neck feels nice. I liked also that there was a sample of their neck cream inside.

This was a really cool product that I've never tried before. I looked real funny while wearing it 🤪. My husband got a good laugh! I could tell a little difference after wearing but it didn't last long.

A jawline and neck mask is always something I seek for. This StriVectin Advanced Sculpture Jawline & Neck Mask is very easy to use and fits well on my small face. My skin does not feel sticking afterwards and no residue. This is a perfect mask on the go before big events.
I love this product so much and it makes my skin feels firmer, smoother . I feel cool and comfortable on the skin. The scent is amazing. I will buy it again and recommend it to my friends.

I wanted to love this product but unfortunately I can't say that I do. The packaging was perfect so you don't have to worry about the item being damaged. For starters, it was a bit tricky to put on the mask so I couldn't imagine an older person doing this alone. There was no smell which was a plus and as promised, the product fits snugly so no need to worry about it slipping after applying. The removal was easy but I notice a difference with this one time application. I would say I probably won't try this product again but I would be interested to see how long time use would look.

This mask is a sculpting jawline and neck mask. While trying it on was a bit of a struggle, keeping it on was a bit uncomfortable due to my ear being bent in the position it was in. But the actual feeling to it felt great.

Love the cooling sensation this mask provides as well as the tightness to my jaw wow neck area afterwards. No scent or funny orders which I appreciate. Now that the weather is warming up this mask feels very cooling and comfortable. Easy to use and apply.
There's nothing glamorous about our aging neck and jawline- enter StriVectin….here to help with this issue that we all have. While we can't turn back the clock - maybe we can slow it down slightly!!

Oh my, what is this? Like it's insane the difference I saw, mind you this is only one application, one mask. It was a little puzzle to remove the plastic film but once I handle that it stays put. I mean I should buy more of these. It was comfortable to use and it was not wet or anything, it just felt cool to the skin. No burning or discomfort.

avis.titre: One time used and I saw the results
avis.texte: It was my first time using this jawline neck mask and was easy to used. My first impression is that the mask feel really good, first you have to apply cream and after you can use the mask. I keeper for 20 minutes, feel good and comfortable. After 20 minute I take out and I see a little but significant difference between how started and how ended. I think it's something that needs to be used diary to see better results but I really liked.

Slightly difficult to attach, I would pull your hair back into a pony. Mask will stick to itself but can be separated again. Does tug on your ears to lift up your neck. Just felt cool, ever so slight tingling. My skin looked good after, nothing major, but possibly with continued use you may see a more dramatic difference.

Strivectin is one of my all time favorite skincare brands. This hydrogel tightening mask for the jaw and neckline delivers visible results to problem areas that are prone to the sagging effects of gravity. This mask is designed to contour and sharpen the jawline with consistent use. The packaging design is simple and functional. The fit is very snug and comfortable. It is the perfect way to add some self care to my daily routine.

avis.titre: Nice Refreshing Mask For The Neck and Jawline
avis.texte: This Mask is nice easy to use and fits perfectly on my face. It smells light and clean and good and the results are awesome. My skin feels soft, supple and smooth and refreshed after using. The packaging is nice and easy to use and once you peel the mask off, it comes off so smoothly and easy to dispose and then followed with the cream, which felt amazing on my face.

I'm probably not the correct age demographic for this one as it seems to be for more mature skin who have experienced loss of firmness under the chin/neck area. Once you read the instructions or watch an instructional video, it's actually super easy to use. The gel adhered to my skin easily, the only thing that was difficult was getting the ear loops to stay on my ears while I was smoothing everything out. I do feel like this is a pricey skincare item as it only comes with one piece per package.

I was gifted theTL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask by StriVectin in exchange for my honest review. This mask is just alright. I found it to be a bit difficult to put it on. The film peeled off wonky, and it was just awkward. I didn't find it particularly uncomfortable to wear. However, I did feel that it was pulling on my ears a bit. I followed the directions and wore the mask for 20 minutes. It was easy to remove and didn't leave any residue. So that's good. I don't really notice any difference in my appearance. Perhaps I would after several applications.
I think the neck mask worked pretty good! It was easy to use and comfortable to wear. I could tell a difference after using it as well. I would definitely purchase more.

I'm impressed with this neck mask so far, specially after leaving it on for a while, in the sense it looked for defined, I was impressed definitely, I would totally buy more. Easy to put on and very comfortable. Consistency is the key as well.

I was so excited to try this product. Instructions were little confusing to follow and understand. Application was very hard. Must watch YouTube video to make it easier. I left it on whole recommended time. My face burned during later part of application. Also was very itchy. After time was up. I removed my face was red for almost an hour. I also had a sticky residue left on some areas of my face which was hard to get off.

While I felt a slight firming for a short time after using the mask, I could not see any visible signs. Possibly after continued use of the mask I may see/feel a noticeable improvement as the website claims however one use it is not worth it.

avis.titre: In love with this mask 10 of 10
avis.texte: It feels good when I applied it on my face. A bit confusing but it works out really well for me. I doesn't feel itchy or anything but it's just the right amount of product to use for me. No residue after I applied it and the cream that it was supposed to be applied on neck; I applied it to my whole face. It feels and smells amazing.
This mask feels cool and comfortable. It was easy to use and after one use, my jawline looked a bit tighter and more lifted. Not permanent, but great for a quick shape up before going out.

I was very sceptical about this mask for neck tightening. However once I tried it this morning I felt that my neck line is not different. It's actually tighter I feel like my muscles there are in better shape. It feels sticky when you remove plastic but there is no residue on the skin and no glue left after removing the mask. I used it as per instructions about 20 min and feel effect for about 2-4 hours after. It has no scent and very easy to use. No side effects.

I like the consistency of the mask, as it feels hydrating without being too sticky or messy. It adheres well to skin, though I do feel like it can be uncomfortable around the ear area due to tightness. Left skin feeling smooth and hydrated. A nice addition to a self care routine.

I wasn't so sure it would work, but I also felt since it is strivectin it has to bc the brand is a high end brand. Im not kidding u when I say it works I can say its cooling no stink kinda uncomfy on the ears but I literally had a jaw line when it was done I just dont know how long that last or how often this would need done to be able to maintain that but I do recommend for sure.

avis.titre: A sculpting mask thats too small for my head!
avis.texte: This sculpting mask did not go too well. I watched the video and tried to apply the mask the way that was shown but it ended up ripping when I tried to get it to go around my ears. It was comfortable and I still wore it as best as I could.
Super effective, it helps sculpt and moisturize my neck, it doesn't irritate and helps with inflammation, my skin feels better and super soft.

I Tried the TL Advanced Sculpting Neck and Jawline Mask and the results were noticeable right away. The mask feels cooling, firming and super hydrating while it's on,and it fits comfortably without slipping. After removing it my skin felt incredibly smooth and soft like baby soft. My neck looked more hydrated and my jawline appeared more defined. The glow it gives is fresh vibrant and healthy-looking. It works fast which makes it perfect before pictures or special moments. Overall it left my skin feeling nourished, lifted, and silky smooth. It's definitely worth it

avis.titre: Felt nice but didn't see a difference
avis.texte: This sculpting mask felt nice and made my skin feel nice while it was on but unfortunately didn't see much of a change, if any after just one use therefore I would not buy again

I really enjoyed this facemask by strivectin. I actually noticed a difference after one use because my jawline appeared to be more pronounced and tighter. Also my skin felt more hydrated and glowing. I wish I could use one of these every single day. I definitely recommend to anybody who wants to hydrate glow or sculpture their face.
I love the feel of the sculpting on my neck. It feels like I'm actually accomplishing something when I'm using it. I am a long time fan of all of your products, never use any other brands.
My skin got irritated. I don't think I'll try the other one. I bought two, unfortunately.

I honestly didn't expect this mask to feel this good. It fits perfectly around the neck and stays in place without sliding. The cooling sensation is super soothing and my neck felt noticeably firmer, smoother and deeply hydrated. My fine lines looked softer and skin around neck looked so good. This is the must have skincare product and must do skincare routine!

I like this. It fit my face well and left my skin feeling soft and tightened. I didn't notice much of a difference using just one, but I think if you used them regularly, you could see a difference. Easy to use.

avis.titre: Cool idea for as sculpting jawline
avis.texte: This is a cool idea to help with sculpting the jawline and neck. I did not notice a change but it may take several attempts. I wish it can't with at least two options. It doesn't leave a residue when removing it and I think it's affordable if not using everyday. The material feels comfortable. I will purchase more to see if it really works.
Sculpt your jaw without any kind of procedure!!! All you have to do is apply it correctly it and keep being consistent. The package gives very clear instructions

avis.titre: Cooling, easy self-care for the neck
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this StriVectin TL Neck Mask. It feels cooling and soothing right away and fits comfortably without slipping. After using it, my neck felt smoother, hydrated, and refreshed! Perfect for an easy self-care moment at home! I'd definitely use this again.

I am incredibly impressed with the results from the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask!! I would like to start with stating that it is a little difficult to open and put on. It easily will stick to itself, so you have to be quick and make sure you look at the instructions don't guess. It was a little small, but it still fit, it was comfortable as well. No scent and It looks a little funny when wearing it but I definitely noticed a difference as soon as the mask came off! Kept it on for 20 minutes before gently removing and discarding the mask. Washed his face. And we both immediately noticed the tightening and sculpting results. I actually purchase the StriVectin TL Advanced Neck & Jawline Face Set, so we used those products immediately after the mask & the results were noticeable right away! We are both VERY impressed! Strivectin is on the pricier side when it comes to skincare but I can confidently say, they're worth every single penny!!
An effective face mask, easy to apply, helps to firm, tighten, and tone the skin and helps with fine lines. It has good adhesion to the skin and is easy to use.
These were fairly easy to place and put on. However, they were very snug on the ears. It left my skin feeling hydrated and firm with very minimal residue.

Aging is one thing. Aging neck is an entirely different story. One thing I'm struggling with actually. But this 20 minute sculpting and tightening neck and jawline mask is great! Cooling, fairly unscented and leaves my skin feeling soft. Get it!

I recently had the opportunity to try the Strivectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask and I felt it made a notable difference in the appearance and texture of my face and neck. The mask was very easy to apply -- simply peel off the backing to the jawline part, stretch to fit across your jawline, press against jaw and chin, and loop the holes around your ears. Then peel the backing from the neck portion and also stretch so loops fit around your ears; press the neck part again the neck. The hydrogel formulation feels cooling and is fine for sensitive skin. The mask adheres with no slippage during the 20 minutes you leave it on. After 20 minutes, I removed the mask to reveal a lifted jawline and smoother, tighter neck. The slight crepiness I have when I move my neck was gone for the day! I definitely would recommend this product for delivering is promised results.

In my mid thirties skincare has become very important to me. After doing my normal skincare routine I put on the Strivectin neck and jawline mask. One use is not enough to notice too much of a difference but with repeated use I believe you can achieve nice results.

This stuff is great! The only thing i will.sau is if you have little ones dont do this mask until they are asleep. I felt like I couldn't really move after putting it on, especially since its on my neck area. So for 29 mins find a hobby of sitting or laying. No burning sensation, fit over my ears.

My first time using a neck mask. It feels incredible. It has a nice cooling sensation and it made my neck feeling very moist and looking better than ever. It's a bit tricky to put it on, but it's not difficult, it's also very comfortable once it's on your neck.
Face felt refreshed and quickly absorbed by my skin. Instructions were easy to follow. My skin felt great after and glowed. Highly recommend this product.
Firms and tightens the jawline and neck with a cooling, comfortable fit. Great for reducing puffiness and smoothing lines fast, but results are temporary. Ideal for a quick pre-event lift.

This TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline and Neck Mask from Strivectin is really easy to use and doesn't feel uncomfortable at all. I like that I can wear this mask and walk around doing my chores, and it stays in place. The hydrogel feels cooling and soothing on the skin. I know that to see real results, I would need to use this mask consistently for a few weeks, but I only had the chance to try it once, so I can't speak to long-term results. What I can say is that after using this mask, my skin felt less puffy around my jawline and chin, and it felt plumped and hydrated.

StriVectin has a great reputation and clearly has high quality products. This jawline and neck mask feels very luxurious, even though it looks silly while I'm wearing it. Make sure you're applying this after cleansing *and* moisturizing your skin. I did not put on serum or moisturizer after cleansing and it felt uncomfortably tight/dry since you need to leave it on for 20 min. Also, the mask is supposed to be tight, but it pulled so hard on my ears that it folded them over. 🤣 I added before, during, and after pictures and noticed a slight difference in my jawline.

avis.titre: Too uncomfortable and just a sticky mess.
avis.texte: This was just a sticky mess. The loops would not stay over my ears at all - the bottom just kept falling off. It was so uncomfortable that I could not keep this on for the required 20 minutes. At first, there was a cooling sensation, but then it felt like it was stinging. Honestly, this would not be my first choice for trying to smooth and firm my neck. I can't comment on the results, because it was too uncomfortable for me.

The StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask was okay. It felt cooling and stayed in place well, but I didn't notice a big difference after using it. The duration was fine and it was easy to wear while relaxing. The packaging is nice and the concept is interesting, but it didn't fully meet my expectations, so I wouldn't personally repurchase or use it on my own.

I was sent the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask to try, and it honestly felt like a spa treatment at home. The mask fits really well around the jawline and neck and stays in place while you wear it. After using it, my skin felt noticeably firmer, smoother, and deeply hydrated, especially along my neck where I usually notice dryness. It gave my skin a nice, refreshed look right away, and my jawline felt more sculpted and toned. The only downside is that it's more of a treatment mask than something you'd use every day, but as a quick pick-me-up or before a special event, it's great. I'm really glad I got to try it.

I recently decided to treat my neck and jawline to something a little more targeted with the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline and Neck Mask—and honestly, I'm impressed. From the first use, the mask felt cooling and comfortable, almost like a gentle hug around my lower face. StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask stays in place surprisingly well, which is a big deal for me because I can't stand masks that slide around. I started noticing that my skin felt firmer and more hydrated. It's not a dramatic overnight transformation, but there's definitely a smoother, more lifted look. The StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask serum absorbs nicely and doesn't leave that sticky weird residue that some tightening products do. What I really love is how pampered this StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask makes me feel. It's such an easy step to add into my routine, but it gives that spa-treatment vibe at home. I wouldn't say it magically sculpts your jawline, but StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask does make the whole area look a little tighter and more refreshed. Overall, StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask has become a nice self-care ritual for me, and I do feel like I'm seeing real benefits—subtle, but noticeable enough to keep it in my rotation. If you're looking to give your neck and jawline some extra attention, this StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask is a solid and reliable choic

I found this product difficult to use and or peel off. I did keep it on for 20 minutes and what happened is I felt the tingle, not sure if good or not. The mask has no fragrance which I like however I didn't see much of a difference after one use. I wouldn't necessarily buy. It didn't bother me however it stung a bit after removal but not a huge big deal.

avis.titre: I think it would've worked with repeated use
avis.texte: I've lost 100 lbs without working out, and I'm going through menopause, which causes your skin to lose collagen and elastin, along with a loss of firmness and sagging around the neck and jawline. So, I was really excited to receive the TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask by StriVectin. After applying the form-fitting Jawline & Neck Mask with hydrogel, I instantly felt its tension and cooling effects, which gave me high hopes. After waiting 20 minutes, I removed the mask and felt that my jaw and neck were more firm, but unfortunately, that didn't last long. I believe that if I had more than one mask paired with their neck cream, I could see better results with continued use. So, it's hard to recommend without knowing if the jaw and neck mask would be effective if I had received more masks.

avis.titre: ...found a way to tighten up that jawline!
avis.texte: StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Neck & Jawline Mask has truly found a way to tighten up that jawline! With its tightening neck cream & mask it's an easy way to assist with those sagging & drooping areas. I would've given it one more star, but it was a little tight on the ears (understandably to get the best lift) & the mask is extremely self adherent & likes to stick to itself easily which is frustrating during application. I would definitely try again & felt it moisturized, tightened & lifted.

I received the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. After using one mask, I can't say I noticed a visible difference yet you really can't expect dramatic results from just a single use. That said, I did enjoy the experience overall. The mask feels very cooling and tightening while it's on, which makes your skin feel firmer and refreshed. The tightening sensation is likely just part of how the mask works, but it still feels nice and luxe. I'd be curious to see if there are more noticeable results with continued use.

This is the first time I have used a product like this. I loved that on the back of the packaging there is a code to scan that shows you a tutorial video. The back of the box also shows detailed pictures and instructions. The mask was very stretchy and laid perfectly on my skin. There was a great amount of gel on the product. It was super simple to use and in my opinion was a great quality product. I didn't really see a visible difference before and after, but my skin felt much firmer and tighter. My skin also felt softer and smoother after use. I think if I used this product regularly it would show visible results. I would definitely use this product again.

I thought this TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask was going to be awesome, but it really isn't anything great. I didn't see any instant results, or long term.. maybe if you use one of these everyday for a while, but then that would be pretty pricey. I'd much rather try out one of the reusable silicone masks and see how well it works with daily use.. I won't be purchasing these, at their price point.
Really nice neck mask product absorbs into the skin does not leave any sticky residue. The mask itself is very stretchy and it fit my elongated face/neck.

This is not normally something I would buy, but received complimentary to try for free my honest review. I didn't feel like it gave an immediate tightening feeling, but maybe using more often would help get those results. Shown are the product, and then the before and after. The mask was easy to put on, but it was very sticky to take off the paper. However, once on your neck/face, it stayed! It was fun to try this out. No scent.

avis.titre: Not for me but maybe for you will.
avis.texte: I tried the TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck mask and it didn't really work out for me. It wasn't hydrating like most masks I've used it felt more like a glue. It was also a bit hard to apply. I personally didn't see much of a difference, but it might work better for others depending on their skin.

I'm obsessed with this mask!! It's so comfortable to wear. The material on the outside is a soft fabric and then you remove a protective liner to expose the gel base to apply that side to your skin. You apply thr mask over you neck and chin and then loop over your ears. It's so comfortable to wear and really gives you a lift! I kept it on for a couple hours. I wish it came with more in the pack but I'll just have to buy more!

avis.titre: My first time trying neck mask
avis.texte: My first time trying neck mask and im in love. I didnt think that my neck could look like im 25 again. Has great cooling sensation and made my neck super plump and moisturised. The only bad thing is that there was only 1 sample of it)) ohh and with a sample i got small moisturizer sample which i put on righr after the mask. Im in love with this product!

avis.titre: Comfortable to use but no change
avis.texte: I was excited to try this neck mask from StriVectin. On the plus side, the mask was comfortable and didn't irritate my skin at all. Unfortunately, I did not notice any change after removing the mask 20 minutes later. Maybe it works better with repeated use? It only came with one mask, so I will not be purchasing another to try.

avis.titre: My skin feels tighter and smoother
avis.texte: StriVectin | TL Advanced Sculpting ​Jawline & Neck Mask is a godsend for my aging neck skin. The mask itself is luxurious, easy to use and doesn't leave any residue behind. The mask felt cool on my skin yet was snug enough to deliver the gel into my skin without any discomfort through the twenty minute application. After one use, the mask delivered the desired result: the skin on my neck and jaw line is tighter and smoother.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again.
avis.texte: I didn't notice any change in the jaw area. I didn't expect a lot but a I thought it be a little tighter. Im disappointed.

avis.titre: Need to use more than once to see results
avis.texte: I received this product from Influenster and StriVectin for free in exchange for my honest review. This is my first time using a product like this. Having only been given one, one-time use mask, I don't feel like I have a true understanding of the product. Honestly, I felt a little ridiculous using the mask as it was a bit uncomfortable around the ears. Not because it hurt, but because it made them flare out while in use. I may have noticed a little bit of face slimming or narrowing after use, but it did not last after just one use. The instructions were also vague. I wasn't sure if I was supposed to use the cream that came with the mask befire or after using the mask and I also wasn't sure if I was supposed to wash my face after use. I don't think this is a product I will use again in the future. As far as scent is concerned, there was a mild, but pleasant scent. The gel mask felt as expected, but the lotion was thicker than my usual moisturizer. My face felt smooth after use, so I didn't feel like I should wash my face afterwards.

I wasn't sold on this sculpting mask. The before and after pictures show no changes; however, maybe if you continue to use this mask over time there might be changes. It is comfortable to use and the application is easy. Strivectin products are expensive so this probably wouldn't be an item I would purchase.

avis.titre: First Neck & Jawline Mask I've tried!
avis.texte: I love face masks but how about our neck? so glad there's a mask for that I can use at home! This mask gives the love or jaw and necks deserve. Even comes with a sample cream to use after. It's a gel pad (lidocaine patches for your back) but not wet so I doesn't move all over the place and comfortable while you wait 20 mins. Will try again!

This really helped my neck before an event, however the next day the part of my chin where the mask was sitting broke out. I bought 3, so I'll have to experiment with putting it on where it only touches my neck, but I think having it slightly over thr chin is what makes it tight against the neck in order to be effective. :(

Very interesting mask, I have never used anything like it. Once I figured how to put it on, I didn't want to take it off and it stayed put, I could even run errands with it on. Very good quality. The gel is very cooling and cozy it feels so nice. I will continue to use this product to see if it gives me a snatch jawline.

This is a bit of a pain to get on and one of the straps ended up ripping when trying to secure it behind my ear. I do like that it doesn't leave a sticky residue when you take it off. As far as noticing a difference not really, then again I don't think I'm the target audience for this product
I really love this product it help me a lot with my chin, its really easy to use and apply, do not have any scent, so its really nice the sensation of this mask

avis.titre: Simple to Use; Not Easy to Apply
avis.texte: I liked the product even though it was troublesome applying it. However once applied, it felt cool and comfortable. I liked that it wasn't messy or oily. It felt like compression to your neck and jawline. I found it to be very moisturizing and it was easy to remove, however I didn't notice any visible difference after using it. It has a very slight clean scent.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was intrigued by the Strivectin TL Advanced Sculpting Neck & Jawline Mask and was excited to have the opportunity to try it. I was a little surprised because most facial sheet masks come with 4-5 masks and this Strivectin Neck & Jawline Mask only came with one single use mask. It was easy to apply and I really liked that it wasn't wet and dripping serum everywhere. Instead it is more of a gel consistency against the skin and the other side is like a fabric. The loops go around your ears and pull the mask tightly against the skin but it isn't too tight or uncomfortable. After 20 minutes the mask is removed and it's supposed to help tighten and firm the skin around the jawline and neck. Unfortunately I didn't notice a difference after removing the mask and because of that I won't be repurchasing in the future.

This gave a cooling effect. It adhears really well to the skin and you can go about your normal routine. I however did not notice much change if any at all. I left it on for 20 minutes while working on Landry and moving my head around did not cause it to fall off.

I used the StriVectin TL Advanced™ Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask one time, and I was pleasantly surprised by the results. The mask fit well around my jawline and neck and stayed in place the whole time. After removing it, my skin felt very hydrated, smooth, and refreshed. I noticed my jawline looked a bit firmer and my neck area felt tighter right away. It was easy to use and felt like a quick at-home spa treatment. Even after one use, my skin looked healthier and more lifted.

I am not sure what I expected with this but it went on smoothly… was tight and fitting around the ears/jaw line… but didn't really see much of a difference. The lotion that came with it to use afterwards was smoothing. There was no residue leftover an it came off very easily.

avis.titre: Well now this is handy! I saw instant results
avis.texte: I immediately saw results with my chin and neck area appearing more sculpted. Not sure how long the results will last with just one use but I know for sure I'll be using them on days I have events. My skin is sensitive but I had no reaction and it was super easy to apply and remove.

I tried the StriVectin TL Advanced™ Sculpting Neck & Jawline Mask, and overall I really liked it. After just one use, I do feel like it made a slight but noticeable difference in how firm and smooth my jawline and neck looked. My skin felt tighter, refreshed, and nicely hydrated afterward. That said, the application was a bit tricky at first because the mask is very sticky, so you do have to take your time placing it correctly. Once it's on, though, it stays put and does its job. This is a great quick pick-me-up treatment when you want your jawline and neck to look more defined and refreshed, especially before an event or a special day. I'd definitely use it again as part of my self-care routine.

I was honestly shocked by how well this worked for snatching my jaw line. It was plenty comfortable and quick to use. Will definitely keep using these to snatch before events! Doesn't leave any sticky residue and stays on comfortably!

I really enjoyed this product… I'd probably buy again and use more consistently but it's a bit pricey. I am very familiar with the brand and it's a very good quality brand, just in the high end price wise. Feels great and relaxing and easy to use. Stays put, no issues or irritation at all:

I didn't really notice a difference between the before and after. Maybe a bit more hydrated and moisturized. It's very sticky, so the application was a bit tricky and kept getting stuck to itself, even with following the instructions and doing one half at a time.

avis.titre: May be worth trying but it doesn't fit well into a
avis.texte: The StriVectin Jawline & Neck Mask is a lifting/firming treatment that takes 20 minutes After cleansing and moisturizing. Pros: It did seem to do something but it isn't very noticeable on 40s skin yet may be more effective for other skin Cons: After moisturizer so it is difficult to fit into a night regimen if you don't like the feeling of the product It hurt behind my ears, which the instructions say is an indicator of effectiveness however it was still loose on my actual jawline and neck despite the pain around my ears The texture of the product doesn't feel great on the skin it is almost slimy as well as cold. I would rather have a product that I can use prior to moisturizing so that I can wash afterwards and complete my regimen Perhaps it should come in different sizes because it didn't fit well on my smaller sized head Summary: it may be worth a try if you are looking for this type of product but it isn't a very pleasant treatment.

The instructions are easy to follow, everything is very clear. The mask lasts 20 minutes, which I think is a good amount of time. It didn't cause me any irritation, and I love that it feels very refreshing. It's easy to use, although I had a little trouble getting it out of the packaging, and if you don't do it carefully, it can stick together and get ruined.

avis.titre: I see a different in my neck
avis.texte: I like that the product has pretty natural ingredients. It was a little difficult to place on the first time cause it got a bit stuck to each other but I feel it's a small learning curve. I do feel that it helped smooth the lines on the neck and it feels nice and cool. It was extremely easy to peel off and the 20min time frame is easy to comply with cause you can do other things while waiting

avis.titre: Not a fan of the feeling
avis.texte: StriVectin sculpting neck and jawline mask has an attractive package but to me that is about it. There is no scent so this would be good for someone that has sensitive skin. Ok trying to put this on is a bit of a workout if you take off the entire backer the product sticks to itself then your fighting to pull it apart it's a mess. I didn't like the mask being around my ears with the sculpting material would have preferred the ears not have the material on it. As for applying if there was a seam between the chin and neck maybe you could apply it easier. Taking it off was no big deal came right off just didn't like the feeling around my ears.

This neck mask was easy to use and very comfortable to wear. It was soft and gentle on the skin and didn't tug on the ears. It is hard to tell about the effectiveness with just one use, but the skin did seem temporarily more "snatched"!
Feels great. I have tried the face mask and like it but this is better. It feels great on and when I take it off my skin feels more elastic and less paper mache.

I was pleasantly surprised by the immediate tightening effect of this jawline mask. I loved that this was great even on my sensitive skin and did not break me out. It was comfortable to wear, did not cause any peeling, itching or redness. There was a lot of instant gratification which definitely makes the price point for this mask worth it. I also loved the bonus sample. I would definitely especially on my weight loss journey to keep my neck line and jaw tight.

I only used the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask once and I was surprised how quickly I noticed a difference. Right after using it my face and neck felt firmer and more lifted almost like a smoothing effect kicked in immediately.Since I've only tried it one time I can't speak for long-term results but it definitely seems like a mask you need to use regularly to see the full benefits. Still for just one use it made my skin feel tighter and more supported which I really liked.

I've been using the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask and, while I loved the cool feel of the hydrogel and how comfortably it fits with the straps around my ears, in my case the results were quite subtle; my skin feels soft and soothed after removing it, but I didn't notice a marked difference in firmness or definition of my jawline. I think to see a real change you'd have to be consistent and use it more regularly; even so, I think it's a good option when I want to give my neck area an immediate boost of freshness.
Application was easy, got nice and tight when strung up by the ears. Got a little itchy towards the end so I took it off a bit early. Definitely tightened things up.
I didn't think this would actually stretch to fit comfortably over my ears, but I was wrong. This mask is comfortable and my skin is looking and feeling great.

This is a great way to treat and tighten your neck and jawline before an event or something important. Treat and tighten with the cream and add this mask when you're ready to make your next appearance. Contours and fits tightly, stretchy material so it hugs entire neck and jawline. No mess easy to travel with and keep on you for the holiday.

I enjoyed this! It felt super moisturizing and comfortable to wear. I usually can't wait to get masks off but felt this could have been on longer. It seemed to firm and tighten a little, felt very smooth after using. I really liked this and feel like results temporarily are pretty good!

This mask felt very relaxing on. The temperature and fit was very comfortable. I was also pleased by the scent as well. But as far as did the product work? I seen slight results but nothing major. I wouldn't mind giving it another try but overall it's very hard to tell if it really worked or not. I feel like it's a product you have to use consistently to see major results.

Sticky and hard to unfold and put on. Uncomfortable around the ears. Felt slimy. Not for me. For a luxury product it should be easy to apply and comfortable to wear, this is neither. And it scared my dogs.

received this mask as part of an Influenster campaign, and I was super curious about it especially because it's specifically for the neck and jawline. Instead of trying it on myself, I tested it on my mom so I could really see visible results. The texture feels cooling and comfortable on the skin, and she mentioned it felt soothing while wearing it. After removing it, her skin looked more hydrated, smoother, and slightly firmer. The jawline area looked a bit more defined, which was exciting to see even after one use. I think this is a great option if you're looking to give extra care and firmness to the neck area. I'll continue testing it and update if we see more long-term results!

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare collection!
avis.texte: This is my first time trying a neck and jawline mask! I'm definitely impressed by these! It is so important to add your neck and chest to your skincare routine, so that these areas get the care that they need to stay looking vibrant and healthy! It's also important to incorporate these areas to help to rewind the clock on aging! While I have neglected these areas in the past, I have begun making them a priority! These masks are so easy to use and I love that they have ear holders to keep the mask in place! This is a firming hydrogel mask with a cooling feel to target puffiness, tighten skin, smooth wrinkles, and define the chin contour! While I didn't see huge results with the first use, I did notice a difference and I am sure I will continue to see results with each continued usage! The mask sticks well to the intended areas and adds hydration! My skin loved these! I love being able to give my neck some TLC! I'll definitely be using these ones again!
This wasn't at all uncomfortable to wear and I didn't feel the length of time was too long to wear either. However I don't feel that the mask actually did anything or made any sort of difference.

I like that it isnt wet and dripping serum everywhere. Instead it is more of a gel consistency which is a nice bonus if you're doing makeup afterwards. Its a perfect fit I can go about and do my errands without fearing it will fall off

As we age, the law of gravity tends to pulls everything down especially our face and neckline. This thoughtful product would help saturate and fulfill the area to tighten with advance cream. This part would be great if there is an event to attend and need a temporary solution around the jawline.

avis.titre: Easy to apply and you do see instant results
avis.texte: The mask was very easy to apply after you straighten it out. It does tend to fold it on itself when you take the adhesive paper off. It has a very cooling effect and I did notice some slight firming when I removed it after about 25 minutes.

I gave the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask a try because I was really curious about the idea of a "quick fix" for sagging and puffiness. The texture was super cooling and felt really nice going on — almost like a spa moment at home. But honestly, after using it, I didn't see a noticeable difference in firmness or contour. It definitely refreshed my skin and gave it a temporary hydrated look, but the tightening or lifting effect just wasn't there for me — at least not after one use. Maybe it works better with consistent use, but for the price, I expected a bit more of a visible result right away.

StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Neck & Jawline Mask left my jawline & neck feeling tightened and lifted as well as hydrated! This mask will have better results with continued use. The mask is formulated with niacinamide and NIA-114 for hydration & skin tightening, firming, smoothing, tone & depuffing. To use, clean skin, unfold the mask & peel off protective film on top half & apply to skin, pulling up tightly & secure behind each ear, then peel off film off bottom half and pull up and secure loops on ears, smooth mask into skin & leave on for 20 minutes, remove and skin should look and feel tighter & smoother. Also in the box is a sample of TL Advanced Tightening Neck Cream to try as well. Highly recommend using the StriVectin Neck & Jawline Mask for smooth, tightened and firmer skin with continued use of these masks!
Very comfortable to wear. Feels cool and smooth. I think if you used this consistently you'd see some tightening of the jowls. Really like the sensation!

avis.titre: Easy to apply and gives a nice cooling effect whil
avis.texte: This application went on easy and was easy to take off. Loved how it gave a cooling effect t while it was on my skin. Just have to be careful when pulling it off the paper so it doesn't stick to itself. I've heard great things about this product but just after one application you can't really tell the difference.

I recently decided to treat my neck and jawline to something a little more targeted with the StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline and Neck Mask—and honestly, I'm impressed. From the initial use, the mask felt cooling and comfortable, almost like a gentle hug around my lower face. It stays in place surprisingly well, which is a big deal for me because I can't stand masks that slide around. I started noticing that my skin felt firmer and more hydrated. It's not a dramatic overnight transformation, but there's definitely a smoother, more lifted look. The mask serum absorbs nicely and doesn't leave that sticky residue some tightening products do. What I really love is how pampered it makes me feel. It's such an easy step to add into my routine, but it gives that spa-treatment vibe at home. I wouldn't say it magically sculpts your jawline, but it does make the whole area look a little tighter and more refreshed. Overall, it's become a nice self-care ritual for me, and I do feel like I'm seeing real benefits—subtle, but noticeable enough to keep it in my rotation. If you're looking to give your neck and jawline some extra attention, this mask is a solid pick.

I was intrigued by the Strivectin TL Advanced Sculpting Neck & Jawline Mask and was excited to have the opportunity to try it. I was a little surprised because most facial sheet masks come with 4-5 masks and this Strivectin Neck & Jawline Mask only came with one single use mask. It was easy to apply and I really liked that it wasn't wet and dripping serum everywhere. Instead it is more of a gel consistency against the skin and the other side is like a fabric. The loops go around your ears and pull the mask tightly against the skin but it isn't too tight or uncomfortable. After 20 minutes the mask is removed and it's supposed to help tighten and firm the skin around the jawline and neck. Unfortunately I didn't notice a difference after removing the mask and because of that I won't be repurchasing in the future.

I'm in my late 40's and am always looking for something to help my aging skin. This StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Neck & Jawline Mask is easy to use and actually stays in place once you hook it around your ears. It does feel a little odd, just because I'm used to face masks, rather than a mask for your chin and jawline. The gel is cooling and didn't notice any scent. The gel is very sticky! I enjoyed sitting and relaxing with this for around 20 minutes, it left my skin feeling a little tighter under the chin which is great as I'm starting to get a bit of a waddle under there! I think I'll purchase this again as I saw some good results and enjoyed taking some self care time to relax. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

I was a bit skeptical about this sculpting mask but honestly I'm quite surprised in 20 mins I got an instant face lift. My jawline is not as round and my double chin temporarily fade away. I like the fact the mask is not messy or drippy and wet. If the price is right I would get it in the future.

avis.titre: A little tricky to apply but immediately notable e
avis.texte: Only 20 minutes with pretty immediate effects felt more hydrated and toned. Might be great before events/photos even! It was a bit tricky to apply-the gel side that applies to the skin is tacky (though doesn't leave you feeling sticky), so was getting stuck to itself. Suggest peeling backing off top ear-loop set, then bottom separately. It does feel tight around the ear but not uncomfortably so, and is important for the compression effect. You're meant to apply this AFTER moisturizer and serum if desired also, as opposed to most masks that go just on cleansed skin...
